changelog:
HealthClaw Guardrails 1.6.0 — Adds FHIR R6 support, enhanced guardrails, and expanded MCP toolset.

- Introduces experimental support for FHIR R6 ballot3 alongside stable FHIR R4 US Core v9.
- Adds 14 MCP tools for secure read, write, audit, statistics, and access control operations.
- Implements PHI redaction on all reads, append-only audit trails, step-up authorization for writes, and strict tenant isolation.
- Supports permission evaluation and two-phase propose/commit pattern for all write operations.
- Documents security guardrails, supported resource types, search parameters, setup, and known limitations.
